stops.name: Aletschwald
stops.quote: The grey-white of ice and rock contrasting with shades of green in the Aletschwald (forest) provides stunning scenic beauty.
stops.english: The grey-white of ice and rock contrasting with shades of green in the Aletschwald (forest) provides stunning scenic beauty.

stops.name: Villa Cassel
stops.quote: Villa Cassel looms like an eagle's nest on the Riederfurka ridge, surrounded by the magnificent Valais mountains.
stops.english: Villa Cassel looms like an eagle's nest on the Riederfurka ridge, surrounded by the magnificent Valais mountains.

stops.name: Aletschhorn
stops.quote: The highly glaciated Aletschhorn towers over the UNESCO-listed Jungfrau-Aletsch area.
stops.english: The highly glaciated Aletschhorn towers over the UNESCO-listed Jungfrau-Aletsch area.

stops.name: Märjelensee lake
stops.quote: On the gentle descent to the Märjelensee lake, cotton grasses and small tarns contrast with the rock and ice.
stops.english: On the gentle descent to the Märjelensee lake, cotton grasses and small tarns contrast with the rock and ice.

stops.name: Bettmerhorn
stops.quote: This area’s most striking downhill run takes you from the Bettmerhorn to the Riederalp.
stops.english: This area’s most striking downhill run takes you from the Bettmerhorn to the Riederalp.

stops.name: Aspi-Titter suspension bridge
stops.quote: The 160-metre-long Aspi-Titter suspension bridge points the way to the idyllic Goms mountain village of Bellwald.
stops.english: The 160-metre-long Aspi-Titter suspension bridge points the way to the idyllic Goms mountain village of Bellwald.

stops.name: TFI Snowpark
stops.quote: Ein Hotspot für alle Freestyler: Denn auf den Kicker-Lines oder der Rail-Line des TFI Snowparks kann man sich so richtig austoben.
stops.english: A hotspot for all freestylers: because you can really let off steam on the kicker lines or the rail line of the TFI Snowpark.
